description: Labels up to 20 texts with 2 to 20 labels you choose, with a confidence from 0 to 1 and a one-line reason per text. One label per text, or several with multi true. Uses the chat model with JSON output; labels are as good as the model's reading of them. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

multi.description: true when a text may take several labels
